dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best of luck.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Haha, I'll take your well-wishes to heart!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Truth be told, I really owe you for helping me so much last time.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Here, you can have these Noctilucous Jades. They're not expensive by any means, but do take them as a keepsake.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: If you're here to make fun of an old man, you picked the wrong one. I don't take any nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Not to scare you off, but I'm none other than the once-illustrious Chang the Ninth of Feiyun Slope!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Back in Liyue, in the good old days, so many Mora went through my hands every day that I couldn't give you an exact number. Anyone who wanted to do business knew it was me they had to impress!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Hmph, even those big-shot Liyue Qixing would have to move aside if I told them they were in my way!

choices.text: So... why did you move here to live as a hermit?

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: It was a somewhat... unexpected turn of events. The business started going downhill, so I thought I'd sell the old abode and move out here, where it's peaceful and quiet, to get away from it all.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: The ancients had a saying, "He who has not known poverty has yet to become a true man." I might only have this hut and my book collection to my name, but I'm optimistic that my time will come again sooner or later.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: I'm wondering about the mineral trade, maybe... Well, I shan't say any more or I'd be handing you a business opportunity on a silver platter!

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: But when my time comes, everyone in Liyue Harbor is going to know that old Chang the Ninth is finally back again!

choices.text: Do you get on with your neighbors?

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: You mean those penniless peasants? Ugh, the fact I even have to live near them...

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: I may be their neighbor now — only due to circumstance I might add — but ohh you mark my words, when I have restored my business to its rightful place in the world, they won't even be worthy to farm the ground I walk upon!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Hmph. If you've no serious business here then take your idle chatter elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: What wind has brought you today? Please, come in, come in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have we met?

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: You don't remember me? It's me, Chang the Ninth! You once bought a mountain of Cor Lapis from me!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I imagine you've met a great many people, it's to be expected that you wouldn't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I remember when I used to do my business on Feiyun Slope. People would fight to do business with me... *sigh* Not like now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, I was able to sell that Cor Lapis at a good price. You effectively saved my life in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I know my gut feeling won't lead me astray. Sure, I've had a few business deals go south, but that which makes money will make money.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Just watch, I used that money to buy more ore. Once my ore business really gets going, I can finally get out of this dump.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: But when my time comes, everyone in Liyue Harbor is going to know that old Chang the Ninth is finally back again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're gonna get going.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Earth be solid beneath your feet. We will meet again in Liyue in due time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Xingqiu...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, that Guhua kid... Haven't seen him since that day. Getting up to something inexplicable no doubt...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: But don't you find it odd? Surely his story isn't as simple as that...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Forget it, it's got nothing to do with me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are the neighbors?

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: You mean those penniless peasants? Ugh, the fact I even have to live near them...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I may be their neighbor now — only due to circumstance I might add — but ohh you mark my words, when I have restored my business to its rightful place in the world, they won't even be worthy to farm the ground I walk upon!
